storage: Keep pouches in the fridge below 5 °C and use within a day or two of opening; do not refreeze or leave out for hours.
looksLike: White liquid sold chilled in 500 ml and 1 L plastic pouches (Amul Taaza, Gokul, Mother Dairy) or in shelf-stable cartons.
howToPick: Check the pack for "toned" and the fat percentage, a manufacture or use-by date within a day or two for pouch milk, and an intact cold pouch. Consumer Voice advises boiling pouch milk before drinking.
shelfLife: Refrigerated pouch milk is normally used within 1 to 2 days; UHT cartons last months unopened (general guidance, not taken from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 200 ml per serving (chilled toned milk). Dishes 96 Gajar Halwa, 98 Mango Lassi and 99 Masala Chai use full-fat milk, which is not this ingredient and is not counted here.
